candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed (Standard: Facility access controls).
candidates.quote: (a)(1) Standard: Facility access controls. Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
candidates.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for facility access controls
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:

(a)(1) Standard: Facility access controls. Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.

(2) Implementation specifications:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification for facility access controls, a covered entity or business associate must establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an emergency (Contingency operations).
candidates.quote: (i) Contingency operations (Addressable). Establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an emergency.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
candidates.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for facility access controls
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:

(a)(1) Standard: Facility access controls. Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.

(2) Implementation specifications:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification for facility access controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft (Facility security plan).
candidates.quote: (ii) Facility security plan (Addressable). Implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
candidates.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for facility access controls
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:

(a)(1) Standard: Facility access controls. Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.

(2) Implementation specifications:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification for facility access controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement procedures to control and validate a person's access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revision (Access control and validation procedures).
candidates.quote: (iii) Access control and validation procedures (Addressable). Implement procedures to control and validate a person's access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revision.

candidates.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for facility access controls
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:

(2) Implementation specifications:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification for facility access controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks) (Maintenance records).
candidates.quote: (iv) Maintenance records (Addressable). Implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks).

scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information (Standard: Workstation use).
candidates.quote: (b) Standard: Workstation use. Implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access electronic protected health information, to restrict access to authorized users (Standard: Workstation security).
candidates.quote: (c) Standard: Workstation security. Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access electronic protected health information, to restrict access to authorized users.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility (Standard: Device and media controls).
candidates.quote: (d)(1) Standard: Device and media controls. Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
candidates.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for device and media controls
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:

(d)(1) Standard: Device and media controls. Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.

(2) Implementation specifications:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, as a required implementation specification under device and media controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored (Disposal).
candidates.quote: (i) Disposal (Required). Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
candidates.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for device and media controls
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:

(d)(1) Standard: Device and media controls. Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.

(2) Implementation specifications:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, as a required implementation specification under device and media controls, a covered entity or business associate must implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use (Media re-use).
candidates.quote: (ii) Media re-use (Required). Implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
candidates.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for device and media controls
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:

(d)(1) Standard: Device and media controls. Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.

(2) Implementation specifications:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification under device and media controls, a covered entity or business associate must maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefore (Accountability).
candidates.quote: (iii) Accountability (Addressable). Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefore.

candidates.actor_quote: A covered entity or business associate
candidates.scope_text: In accordance with § 164.306, as an implementation specification for device and media controls
scope_quotes: A covered entity or business associate must, in accordance with § 164.306:

(d)(1) Standard: Device and media controls. Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.

(2) Implementation specifications:
candidates.summary: In accordance with § 164.306, as an addressable implementation specification under device and media controls, a covered entity or business associate must create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment (Data backup and storage).
candidates.quote: (iv) Data backup and storage (Addressable). Create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment.
